text:
Haruki: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Leadership asked us to capture exact launch windows, owners, and any "MUST" blockers vs things we can cut to hit dates. Post a one-line status + MUST/CAN_DEFER.

Sana: API status: aiming for GA at the start of Q3 (rough window 3-5w). Owner: Sana (Platform). MUST: signed SLA and final billing meter names. CAN_DEFER: non-essential admin endpoints and extended telemetry fields. Structured-output/tool-calls are in private beta and not blockers for Phase 1.

Bea: Gateway note: found a race where streaming + short sync calls interact with the token bucket. Patch submitted (PR #8421). Running a 24h canary in staging now. If green will promote to the canary cohort tomorrow. Status: in-PR -> staging canary. CAN_DEFER if we gate with canary, but prefer fix pre-GA.

Tom: Runtime/Dedicated note: we need a Dedicated acceptance test that validates p99 tail under the GA workload mix. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 48h observation windows at each step. Gate = p99 <= 1.25x baseline AND no sustained OOMs. Owner: Tom (Eng-runtime). MUST.

Felix: Console scope clarification: Phase A (mid-Q3) = admin UX, rollout UI, per-route model pins, core dashboards. Phase B (Q4) = Optimize panels, quantization-control UX, external APM connectors. Owner: Felix (Console PM). MUST: rollout UI and model pinning. CAN_DEFER: APM connector and advanced quantization table.

Sana: Optimize timeline: public beta late-Q3, GA in Q4. Needs 3 production evals and a minimal UI showing estimated cost delta for each recommendation. Owner: Sana + Optimize research. MUST: infra quota for per-tenant batched experiments (INFRA ticket open). CAN_DEFER: full ordering/prioritization of recommendations.

Bea: Canary update: promoted patch at 11:10. Staging reproducer shows >90% reduction in stall rate. Running 24h soak; if no regressions will request canary rollout. :white_check_mark:

Tom: Good. Once Bea confirms canary health, runtime will kick the Dedicated acceptance canary on Thursday. I'll post the p99 dashboard and the exact alert queries.

finance-bot: Reminder: final pricing & meter names required 7 business days before GA. Finance owner: @Marcus. MUST.

Haruki: Leadership question: can we dark-launch advanced Console widgets behind flags to shorten QA?

Felix: Yes — we can dark-launch and ship core flows visible only. That reduces QA surface. Marking advanced widgets CAN_DEFER.

Sana: Small ask to leadership: please prioritize SLA legal redline and the infra quota for Optimize experiments. Those two unblock the GA/beta schedule.

Bea: Risk note: if staging soak fails we have a 48h hotfix path. That could push GA ~1 week. Will update here if soak fails.

Haruki: Action items I captured: 1) Sana to publish consolidated checklist + owner matrix by EOD tomorrow; 2) Bea to post staging soak link and canary request; 3) Tom to run Dedicated acceptance canary after green canary and post p99; 4) Marcus/Finance to confirm meter names; 5) Felix to publish Console Phase A scope and flag advanced widgets.

ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Fri 09:00 PT.

Sana: I'll drop the checklist link here once ready and tag owners. If anything slides, please update this thread with a one-line slip (e.g., "Bea: staging soak failed -> +3d"). :thumbsup:
